STH_andorian_flavour.4.name: Ushaan
STH_andorian_flavour.5.desc:
[officerA.GetName] et [officerB.GetName] se tiennent dans l'arène improvisée à bord du vaisseau amiral de [Root.GetFleetName]. 

'Je vous souhaite une mort rapide, Capitaine.' lance [officerB.GetName], qui se positionne afin de laisser [officerA.GetName] porter le premier coup. 

Le capitaine [officerA.GetName] dégaine son ushaan-tor et plonge sur [officerB.GetName], qui pare sans effort. L'entrechoquement des armes se répercute dans toute la sale, tandis que les spectateurs observent le silence. 

Les adversaires commencent à respirer bruyamment alors que la bataille se poursuit. Une coup de pied frappe le capitaine [officerA.GetName] à la poitrine, repoussant [officerA.GetHerHim] dans un coin de l'arène, accordant un instant de répit aux combattants. 

[officerB.GetName] lance une série de frappes fatiguées vers [officerA.GetName], qui les esquive alors qu'[officerA.GetSheHe] attend une ouverture. Soudain, les yeux de [officerA.GetName] s'écarquillent de panique et [officerA.GetSheHe] est emporté par son élan. Le ushaan-tor de [officerB.GetName] s'enfonce dans la poitrine de [officerA.GetName] et quelques instants plus tard, [officerA.GetSheHe] s'effondre sur le sol, mort.
STH_andorian_flavour.5.name: Ushaan
STH_andromeda.1.desc: Reports are coming in from the planet [andromeda_pre_planet_1.GetName] they are under attack and taking heavy damage from an unknown assailant with powerful weaponary. They request aid from [root.GetName] as soon as possible.
STH_andromeda.1.name: Planet under siege
STH_andromeda.10.desc: Admiral Vance has confirmed that his teams have set up a base of operations close to [Root.Capital_scope.GetName] and they should be able to periodically bring additional ships to aid us in the battle against the Andromedan Invasion fleets.
STH_andromeda.10.name: Future Starfleet base set up
STH_andromeda.1007.desc:
A massive tear in the fabric of space itself has appeared in the [andromeda_origin_system.GetName] system! As informed it looks like the Andromedans are opening the tears as some kind of one-way portal from their galaxy. Fleets of strange vessels are pouring out, attacking everything in sight. This looks like the beginning of their major invasion!

We have intercepted a powerful signal being sent from the arriving vessels to somewhere on the other side of the portal. It sounds like... a war cry.
STH_andromeda.1007.name: Andromedan Invasion
STH_andromeda.1008.desc:
Instruments across the [Root.GetName] have suddenly picked up a subspace power surge of massive proportions coming from somewhere within our galaxy. Our scientists are struggling to come up with an explanation for this event - nothing of its like has ever been recorded.

The exact origin point of this sudden power surge has yet to be identified, but we are still in the process of analyzing the available data.
STH_andromeda.1008.name: Galactic Power Surge
STH_andromeda.1009.desc:
The source of the massive power surge we detected earlier has been identified. It comes from some kind of gigantic subspace tear in the [andromeda_origin_system.GetName] system. Fleets of strange spacecraft are pouring out of this portal, and early reports speak of indiscriminate attacks against everyone coming into contact with them.

We have intercepted a powerful signal being sent from the arriving vessels to somewhere on the other side of the portal. It sounds like... a war cry.
STH_andromeda.1009.name: Source of signal detected
STH_andromeda.1010.desc: We... are the Andromedans... all life in this Galaxy will end at our hands... prepare for your doom.
STH_andromeda.1010.name: Intercepted Transmission
STH_andromeda.1013.desc:
The dimensional portal in the [andromeda_origin_system.GetName] system has been destroyed! This means that the Andromedan invaders can no longer receive reinforcements from their galaxy. 

With the destruction of this portal, the end of these invasions is finally in sight. A profound sense of elation has settled over most of the galaxy. The [portal_killer.GetName] has won much admiration, since it was their ships that struck the final blow against the portal. The crews of those vessels will be celebrated as heroes for generations to come.
STH_andromeda.1013.name: Andromedan Portal destroyed
STH_andromeda.1016.desc: A major blow has been struck against the invaders from Andromeda with the destruction of one of their portals.
STH_andromeda.1016.name: First Portal Destroyed
STH_andromeda.1050.desc: ...behold... the glory... of the Andromedan race ... the last race you will ever see before you are destroyed.
STH_andromeda.1050.name: Incoming Message
STH_andromeda.11.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] we are picking up energy signitures from various locations across the quadrant, it appears the Andromedan fleets are massing and forming gateways to bring in more ships. 

We must prepare our fleets and rally the galaxy to come to defend itself.
STH_andromeda.11.name: The Invasion Begins
STH_andromeda.1110.desc:
Our instruments have detected a new subspace power surge, this time coming from the [second_portal_system.GetName] system! A second massive wormhole has appeared, and its energy signature appears to be almost identical to that of the first dimensional rift which opened in our galaxy.

It looks like the mysterious invaders have opened a second gateway to their realm through which they can send even more reinforcements.
STH_andromeda.1110.name: A second portal
STH_andromeda.1116.name: Second Portal Destroyed
STH_andromeda.1117.desc:
The second dimensional portal that appeared in our galaxy has been destroyed! It can no longer be used by the Andromedans to reinforce their numbers.

We cannot rest easy, however, until every single portal has been destroyed. Only then will the connection between our galaxy and theirs be permanently severed.
STH_andromeda.1117.name: Second Portal Destroyed
STH_andromeda.1210.desc:
A third dimensional portal has appeared in the [third_portal_system.GetName] system! Who does this one belong to?

We are picking up a transmission coming from the other side of it.
STH_andromeda.1210.name: Third Portal
STH_andromeda.1211.desc: We come to join the fight... prepared to meet your end.
STH_andromeda.1211.name: Transmission
STH_andromeda.1216.name: Third Portal Destroyed
STH_andromeda.1217.desc:
The third dimensional portal that appeared in the [andromeda_origin_system.GetName] system is no more. It will no longer be used by the Andromedans to bridge the gap between their galaxy and ours.

We cannot rest easy, however, until every single portal has been destroyed. Only then will the connection between our galaxy and theirs be permanently severed.
STH_andromeda.1217.name: Third Portal Destroyed
STH_andromeda.1271.desc:
The last vestiges of the Andromedan invaders have been wiped out, hopefully ridding the galaxy of this threat for good.

Species everywhere are celebrating the news of this great victory, safe at last in the knowledge that they won't be eliminated by this vicious attack after all. Perhaps this is the beginning of a new era of galactic cooperation and friendship?
STH_andromeda.1271.name: Andromeda Invasion Defeated
STH_andromeda.2.desc:
As the fleet enters orbit of [andromeda_pre_planet_1.GetName] the devastation can be seen by all. Vast regions of the planet's surface reduced to charred debris and the casulty reports make concerning reading. 

More worrying is that the attackers fled the scene before they could be ID. 

Whomever poccesses this much firepower and speed is a considerable threat. Our scientists recommend we remain in orbit to look for any clues on who might be behind this attack, whilst our military commanders recommend suring up our defences.
STH_andromeda.2.name: Attackers Flee
STH_andromeda.3.desc: Our scientists have uncovered some interesting information about the culprits who attacked our planet a high spike in X-rays consistant with an object crossing the galactic barrier. They believe that they should be able to scan for these energy reading and provide us with an early warning of future attacks.
STH_andromeda.3.name: Clues found
STH_andromeda.4.desc: All outbound communication from [andromeda_pre_planet_2.GetName] have stopped and planetary comm networks have gone offline. It appears our mysterious attackers have struck again with catastrophic impact, reducing [andromeda_pre_planet_2.GetName] to a shattered ruin of the world it once was. This is a clear act of war against [root.GetName] and must not go unanswered.
STH_andromeda.4.name: [andromeda_pre_planet_2.GetName] destroyed by attackers
STH_andromeda.5.desc: Our early warning system has paid off as the tell tale signs of our attackers were found approaching the orbit of [andromeda_pre_planet_3.GetName]. With the planet in clear danger we must mass our fleets and defend our people.
STH_andromeda.5.name: [andromeda_pre_planet_3.GetName] under attack
STH_andromeda.6.name: There is another ship entering the battle
STH_andromeda.7.desc: Despite putting up a tough fight the mysterious ship has finally been destroyed thanks to the brilliant efforts of our fleets. Maybe this will bring justice for those who lost their lives and provide the answers we need to understand why we are under attack.
STH_andromeda.7.name: Invaders Ship Destroyed
STH_andromeda.8.desc:
Greetings [Root.GetRulerName] [Root.GetRulerName], you must forgive this intrusion, my crew and I risk much by breaching the Temporal accords to speak with you today but the situation is grave. My name is Fleet Admiral Charles Vance and I am an officer in Starfleet from the 32nd Century. 

The enemy you face has been provided with technology from my future and the ability to cross to our galaxy from the Andromeda Galaxy in a bid to launch a preemptive strike against the races of the Milky Way. Their attacks against us in our own time failed and now they hope to destroy all life here to ensure they succeed. 

 I have heard many stories of the Starfleet of this era and many of you are heroes and legends to us, now we must help you, we can set up a base of operations and bring forth reinforcements to help ensure our future is not lost.
STH_andromeda.8.name: Incoming hail from Starfleet?
STH_andromeda.9.desc:
Greetings [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], you must forgive this intrusion, my crew and I risk much by breaching the Temporal accords to speak with you today but the situation is grave. My name is Fleet Admiral Charles Vance and I am an officer in Starfleet, but not the Starfleet you know, we are from the 32nd Century. 

The enemy you face has been provided with technology from my future and the ability to cross to our galaxy from the Andromeda Galaxy in a bid to launch a preemptive strike against the races of the Milky Way. Their attacks against us in our own time failed and now they hope to destroy all life here to ensure they succeed. We must be allowed to help you, we can bring forth reinforcements to help ensure our future is not lost.
STH_andromeda.9.name: Incoming hail from Starfleet
STH_andromeda.9998.desc:
[Root.GetName], you and your brave crews have my thanks for their work in ensuring that the galaxy has a future safe from the Andromedan threat. 

We must now return to our own time, now that it has been secured. Rest assured that the future is in safe hands.

See you out there!
STH_andromeda.9998.name: The Future is safe
STH_archaeology_events.1.desc: A number of crew have been killed on [From.Planet.GetName] following the collapse of a tunnel near the excavation site after a structural integrity generator failed due to poor maintenance.
STH_archaeology_events.1.name: Tunnel Collapse
STH_archaeology_events.10.desc:
The investigation of the [From.GetDigSiteOriginator] facility has stumbled upon a cache of artefacts of unknown purpose. 

The artefacts were recovered when a console was accidentally activated, triggering the rematerialisation sequence on what was revealed to be a transporter pad. [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the [From.GetDigSiteOriginator] builders of the facility must have possessed advanced transporter technology to enable them to preserve items in transporter stasis indefinitely without degradation.
STH_archaeology_events.10.name: [From.GetDigSiteOriginator] Artefacts
STH_archaeology_events.100.desc:
The chroniton pulses observed from orbit have been localised to a single source, several kilometres below the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. 

After several days of analysis, scientists from the [Root.GetName] have been able to partially scan through the distortion bubble around the source of the chronitons and have detected what appears to be a [Root.Owner.GetName] vessel surrounded by rock.
STH_archaeology_events.100.name: Buried Starship
STH_archaeology_events.11.desc:
[Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] has been injured after the investigation of the [From.GetDigSiteOriginator] facility stumbled upon a cache of artefacts of unknown purpose. 

The artefacts were recovered when a console was accidentally activated, triggering the rematerialisation sequence on what was revealed to be a transporter pad. [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] was knocked back by a modest explosion caused by the transporter-overlay of one of a [From.GetDigSiteOriginator] artefact and a portable generator from the [Root.GetFleetName].
STH_archaeology_events.11.name: [From.GetDigSiteOriginator] Artefacts
STH_archaeology_events.110.desc:
The [Root.Owner.GetName] starship beneath the surface of [From.Planet.GetName] has eluded identification, conforming to no known configuration of ships reported missing or otherwise. 

Engineers from the [Root.GetName] have excavated a number of tunnels to the edge of the chroniton distortion bubble surrounding the vessel, and construction has begun on an localised subspace inverter, which is believed will be able to disperse the chroniton radiation.
STH_archaeology_events.110.name: Buried Starship
STH_archaeology_events.12.desc:
Several crew have been killed investigating the [From.GetDigSiteOriginator] facility, after an internal security system was accidentally triggered. 

Luckily the power cells connected to the security grid were already at reduced capacity, but the automated systems were still able to vaporise a number of the [Root.GetFleetName]'s crew before they were fully drained.
STH_archaeology_events.12.name: [From.GetDigSiteOriginator] Security Systems Activated
STH_archaeology_events.120.desc:
The subspace inverter has successfully dispersed the chroniton bubble around the buried [Root.Owner.GetName] vessel. 

As a security team from the [Root.GetName] sweeps into the ship, the mystery only deepens. The vessel is from the future. 

While all computer systems have been completely disabled, a single datapad on the bridge shows a log entry from nearly sixty years in the future. 

Further analysis of the ship indicates that while almost all of its systems have been destroyed, there is still a wealth of recoverable technology to be unearthed. [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.Leader.GetName] orders immediate excavation of the vessel, for analysis on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].
STH_archaeology_events.120.name: Buried Starship
STH_archaeology_events.13.desc:
[Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] has been injured investigating the [From.GetDigSiteOriginator] facility, after an internal security system was accidentally triggered. 

Luckily the power cells connected to the security grid were already at reduced capacity, but the automated systems were still able to stun and severely wound the [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] before they were fully drained.
STH_archaeology_events.13.name: [From.GetDigSiteOriginator] Security Systems Activated
STH_archaeology_events.130.desc:
The vessel from the future has been completely unearthed from the kilometres of rock it was buried under on [From.Planet.GetName], and using the [Root.GetName]'s [Root.Owner.GetTractorBeam] soon sees it raised into low orbit. 

As the ship enters warp alongside a number of tug vessels, [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.Leader.GetName] reads the only log entry to be even partially recovered. 

 ---s log, stardate---. We have detected a te---ral --ortion in the ----- manifold. We are --- but --- must ---andon ship.'
STH_archaeology_events.130.name: Buried Starship
STH_archaeology_events.14.desc: Unknown system fluctuations have caused a plasma conduit overload at a manned console onboard the ship, resulting in an explosion and numerous casualties.
STH_archaeology_events.14.name: System Malfunction
STH_archaeology_events.140.desc:
A number of crew have been killed by exposure to chroniton radiation while attempting to gain access to the vessel buried on [From.Planet.GetName]. 

Initial investigations suggest the chroniton radiation inoculations provided to the crew were in fact tachyon radiation inoculations. The medical officer responsible for the mixup has been disciplined.
STH_archaeology_events.140.name: Chroniton Radiation Exposure
STH_archaeology_events.141.desc:
A substantial number of crew have been killed by exposure to chroniton radiation while attempting to gain access to the vessel buried on [From.Planet.GetName]. 

Initial investigations suggest the chroniton radiation inoculations provided to the crew were in fact tachyon radiation inoculations, created following a failure in the medical replication suite.
STH_archaeology_events.141.name: Chroniton Radiation Exposure
STH_archaeology_events.142.desc: Following a surge in chroniton radiation, a crew member working on the excavation on [From.Planet.GetName] has ingeniously managed to convert a part of the radiation to storable energy using the [Root.GetName]'s deflector array and several high-grade EPS capacitors.
STH_archaeology_events.142.name: Chroniton Radiation Exposure
STH_archaeology_events.143.desc:
While investigating the vessel from the future, the expedition has discovered a number of log fragments preserved in one of the ship's crew quarters. 

While the logs shed little light on the identities of the crew themselves, linguistic analysis has revealed some interesting cultural trends.
STH_archaeology_events.143.name: Future Starship Investigation
STH_archaeology_events.144.desc:
While investigating the vessel from the future, the expedition has discovered a number of partial sensor logs recoverable from the ship's navigation computer interface. 

While the logs shed little light on the circumstances of the ship's passage back in time, the logs themselves contain high resolution scans of a number of astronomical phenomena.
STH_archaeology_events.144.name: Future Starship Investigation
STH_archaeology_events.145.desc:
While investigating the vessel from the future, the expedition has discovered a number of fully charged energy storage devices in the ship's cargo bay. 

While the exact workings of the energy stores are a mystery, they do use an interface compatible with current standards.
STH_archaeology_events.145.name: Future Starship Investigation
STH_archaeology_events.15.desc: Unknown system fluctuations have caused numerous plasma conduit line overloads at manned consoles onboard the ship, resulting in explosions and numerous casualties.
STH_archaeology_events.15.name: System Malfunction
STH_archaeology_events.16.desc: Unknown system fluctuations have caused all airlocks on one of the lower decks to decompress at once, resulting in a large loss of crew and life.
STH_archaeology_events.16.name: System Malfunction
STH_archaeology_events.17.desc: System fluctuations have been identified and repaired by a member of crew, giving some insight into the cause of these errors.
STH_archaeology_events.17.name: System Malfunction
STH_archaeology_events.18.desc: The treacherous conditions on the planet's surface have gotten much worse, a deadly sand storm springs up from out of nowhere, but still [Leader.GetName] presses onwards in their trance-like state. Oblivious to the injuries sustained by their crew.
STH_archaeology_events.18.name: Sand Storm!
STH_archaeology_events.19.desc:
Just as the expedition started to believe they were safe, the ground beneath them gives way, luckily [Leader.GetName] was able to avoid injury, but a number of the expedition party were not so lucky. 

The company doctor recommend immediate evac for the injured, whilst [Leader.GetName] insists on continuing the journey.
STH_archaeology_events.19.name: Sink Hole
STH_archaeology_events.2.desc: A large number of crew have been killed on [From.Planet.GetName] following the collapse of a tunnel near the excavation site after a series of structural integrity generators failed due to poor maintenance of the batteries powering them.
STH_archaeology_events.2.name: Tunnel Collapse
STH_archaeology_events.20.desc: Throughout the search [Leader.GetName] has remained single minded as if transfixed by a vision only they can see, but now suddenly as if guided by a mysterious source they double their pace, muttering that the end is close Mr Russell.
STH_archaeology_events.20.name: A mysterious clue
STH_archaeology_events.21.desc: Suddenly [Leader.GetName] stumbled as the ground beneath them gives way. The medic rushes to their aid and notes that the Captain has taken a notible injury, yet they seem unaware of the pain and damage they have caused themselves.
STH_archaeology_events.21.name: Leader injured
STH_archaeology_events.22.desc: All of a sudden [Leader.GetName] collapses to the ground, uttering a single message, that they have failed the prophets before closing their eyes and passing away. Whatever has happened will remain a mystery between [Leader.GetName] and the Celestial Beings.
STH_archaeology_events.22.name: [Leader.GetName] killed
STH_archaeology_events.23.desc: The investigation continues into the local population, however as [Leader.GetName] is reviewing the team's workload for the current day they identify a request order for an unknown vessel to be dispatched to the planet's surface. The co-ordinates lead to a large lake just south of the Ba'ku village.
STH_archaeology_events.23.name: Mission to Ba'ku
STH_archaeology_events.24.desc: The observation team led by [Leader.GetName] have sent back an interesting report on the local residents of the planet, there has been clear evidence that prolonged resident beneath the Metaphasic radiation of the planets ring structure has enhanced the Ba'ku's cognitive abilities. The levels of focus and mental discipline shown by the Ba'ku mirrors even the most advanced telepathic species of the Alpha Quadrant, one scientist hypothesized that they might even be able to manipulate other perception of time itself.
STH_archaeology_events.24.name: Mission to Ba'ku
STH_archaeology_events.25.desc: We have received a further update from the team in the Briar Patch. The current view from [Leader.GetName] is that despite their outward appearance the Baku are much older than they outwardly appear. The planet's unique radiation appears to have a regenerative effect on the population, something that seems to be of keen interest to our Son'a partners.
STH_archaeology_events.25.name: Mission to Ba'ku
STH_archaeology_events.3.desc: [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.Leader.GetName] has heroically saved the lives of dozens of crew following collapse of a portion of the tunnel network near the excavation site on [From.Planet.GetName]. The [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] risked injury to keep a series of structural integrity generators online long enough for the crew to escape.
STH_archaeology_events.3.name: Tunnel Collapse

STH_archaeology_events.5.desc: [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.Leader.GetName] has been killed, heroically saving the lives of dozens of crew following collapse of a portion of the tunnel network near the excavation site on [From.Planet.GetName]. STH_archaeology_events.5.name: Tunnel Collapse
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_event.1.desc:
Le capitaine [Root.GetLeaderName] ouvre un canal à la source de la transmission sur la surface et est accueilli par un système automatisé de communication holographique. Il pose plusieurs questions sur l'intention de [Root.GetFleetName] d'acheter, mais révèle peu avant de fermer le canal. 

Le capitaine prépare et mène une équipe d'exploration composée d'officiers supérieurs à la planète, ils se téléportent dans la végétation épaisse. Après quelques instants, le chef de la sécurité a remarqué des débris de tritanium dans la région, endommagés d'une manière bien au-delà de notre technologie actuelle. 

 Le premier officier est accosté par ce qui semble être un commandant de la flotte, mais après une série de questions suspectes, l'imposteur se révèle comme un autre hologramme, juste avant qu'une série de drones d'armées attaquent l'équipe d'exploration. Le groupe repousse la première vague de drones, mais est forcé de se retirer dans une grotte voisine après que le médecin-chef a été blessé. 

 En orbite, la [Root.GetFleetName] est attaqué par une plate-forme orbitale invisible, les communications autour de la planète semblent être brouillé.
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_event.1.name: L'Arsenal De La Liberté
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_event.2.desc:
Capitaine [Root.GetLeaderName] et l'équipe d'exploration exécutent une campagne de guérilla héroïque contre la source des drones de combat, une usine automatisée encore vierge et décorée avec des publicités étrangères. Après un combat prolongé à travers les entrailles de l'usine, l'équipe a enfin atteint le noyau de l'ordinateur central et a désactivé avec succès l'ensemble du réseau de défense de l'usine. 

 En orbite, la plate-forme d'arme se désactive quelque moments 0après l'effondrement des boucliers de la [Root.GetFleetName]. 

L' usine sur la surface semble intacte, et avec un effort minimal pourrait être redémarré avec de nouvelles routines.
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_event.2.name: L'Arsenal De La Liberté
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_event.3.desc:
Le capitaine [Root.GetLeaderName] et l'équipe d'exploration mènent une campagne de guérilla héroïque contre la source des drones de combat de surface, une usine automatisée encore intacte et décorée de publicités extraterrestres. Après un long combat de phaseurs dans les entrailles de l'usine, l'équipe d'exploration atteint le cœur de l'ordinateur central et détruit avec succès tout le réseau de défense de l'usine. 

En orbite, la plate-forme d'armes bégaie jusqu'à l'inactivité quelques instants après l'effondrement des boucliers du [Root.GetFleetName], et tombe dans l'atmosphère en se désintégrant lors de la rentrée. 

L'usine à la surface commence à souffrir d'une défaillance en cascade de son générateur de matière/antimatière. L'équipe d'exploration part quelques instants avant que le site de l'usine ne soit vaporisé.
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_event.3.name: L'Arsenal De La Liberté
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_event.4.desc:
Le capitaine [Root.GetLeaderName] et l'équipe d'exploration mènent une campagne de guérilla héroïque contre la source des drones de combat de surface, une usine automatisée encore intacte et décorée de publicités extraterrestres.Après un long combat de phaseurs dans les entrailles de l'usine, l'équipe d'exploration atteint le cœur de l'ordinateur central et détruit avec succès tout le réseau de défense de l'usine, mais pas avant qu'un relais de puissance n'explose, tuant le capitaine [Root.GetLeaderName]. 

En orbite, la plate-forme d'armes bégaie jusqu'à l'inactivité quelques instants après l'effondrement des boucliers du [Root.GetFleetName], et tombe dans l'atmosphère en se désintégrant lors de la rentrée. 

L'usine à la surface commence à souffrir d'une défaillance en cascade de son générateur de matière/antimatière. L'équipe d'exploration part quelques instants avant que le site de l'usine ne soit vaporisé.
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_event.4.name: L'Arsenal De La Liberté
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_event.5.desc:
Le capitaine [Root.GetLeaderName] et l'équipe d'exploration ont fabriqué plusieurs communicateurs et tricordeurs pour couper le brouillage du signal. Le capitaine demande à parler à nouveau avec le représentant holographique et quelques instants plus tard, il apparaît dans la grotte tandis qu'une série de publicités holographiques montrent divers produits extraterrestres derrière lui. 

Une conversation avec l'hologramme s'ensuit et il révèle son but en tant que mécanisme pour faciliter la vente de la principale exportation de la planète - les systèmes d'armes avancés - et que les attaques jusqu'à présent ont fait partie de sa routine de démonstration de vente préprogrammée. 

L'équipe d'exploration est en mesure de supposer que la civilisation responsable des systèmes d'armes doit avoir été détruite par ses propres inventions. 

Après de nombreuses négociations, le capitaine [Root.GetLeaderName] est en mesure de persuader l'hologramme de se retirer à condition que l'ensemble de l'installation d'armement soit acheté pour une somme importante. 

L'hologramme insiste pour inclure une série de documents de recherche au bon de commande, augmentant le coût de 25% mais fournissant à nos scientifiques une mine d'informations.
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_event.5.name: L'Arsenal De La Liberté
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_event.6.desc:
Le capitaine [Root.GetLeaderName] et l'équipe d'exploration ont fabriqué plusieurs communicateurs et tricordeurs pour couper le brouillage du signal. Le capitaine demande à parler à nouveau avec le représentant holographique et quelques instants plus tard, il apparaît dans la grotte tandis qu'une série de publicités holographiques montrent divers produits extraterrestres derrière lui. 

Une conversation avec l'hologramme s'ensuit et il révèle son but en tant que mécanisme pour faciliter la vente de la principale exportation de la planète - les systèmes d'armes avancés - et que les attaques jusqu'à présent ont fait partie de sa routine de démonstration de vente préprogrammée. 

L'équipe d'exploration est capable de supposer que la civilisation, responsable des systèmes d'armes, a dû être détruite par leurs propres inventions. 

Après de nombreuses négociations, le capitaine [Root.GetLeaderName] est en mesure de persuader l'hologramme de se retirer à condition que l'ensemble de l'installation d'armement soit acheté pour une somme importante. Le capitaine est capable de négocier avec succès une réduction du coût de l'installation par rapport au prix demandé. L'hologramme disparaît, la matrice étant apparemment supprimée au moment où la vente est confirmée.
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_event.6.name: L'Arsenal De La Liberté
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_event.7.desc:
Le timonier du [Root.GetFleetName] prend la décision de quitter l'orbite pour sauver le navire d'une destruction imminente, en supposant que l'équipe d'exploration a été perdue lors du black-out des communications. 

La plateforme d'armes suit cependant, et après une série de manœuvres inspirées dans tout le système stellaire, la plateforme rattrape finalement le [Root.GetFleetName]. Un tir chanceux fait tomber les protections de confinement de l'antimatière du navire, et le navire est vaporisé avec toutes les mains perdues. La plateforme d'armes est prise dans l'explosion, et d'une manière ou d'une autre l'énergie est canalisée vers le faisceau de transfert d'énergie de la plateforme vers la planète. L'installation de drones à la surface est détruite, tuant l'équipe d'exploration.
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_event.7.name: L'Arsenal De La Liberté
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_event.8.desc:
Le timonier du [Root.GetFleetName] prend la décision de quitter l'orbite pour sauver le navire d'une destruction imminente, en supposant que l'équipe d'exploration a été perdue lors du black-out des communications. 

La plateforme d'armes suit cependant, et après une série de manœuvres inspirées dans tout le système stellaire, la plateforme rattrape finalement le [Root.GetFleetName].Un coup de chance fait tomber les protections antimatière de la plate-forme d'armes et celle-ci est vaporisée. D'une manière ou d'une autre, une partie de l'énergie de l'explosion est redirigée vers le canal de transfert d'énergie de la plateforme vers la planète. L'installation de drones à la surface est détruite. L'équipe d'exploration est capable de se téléporter vers le vaisseau avec les restes d'un certain nombre de drones détruits.
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_event.8.name: L'Arsenal De La Liberté
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_fail.1.desc:
Le capitaine [Root.GetLeaderName] ouvre un canal vers la source de la transmission à la surface et est accueilli par un système de communication holographique automatisé. Il se renseigne à plusieurs reprises sur l'intention d'achat du [Root.GetFleetName], mais ne révèle pas grand-chose avant de fermer le canal. 

Le capitaine [Root.GetLeaderName] se prépare à emmener une équipe de cadres supérieurs sur la planète, mais il est interrompu par l'apparition soudaine d'une plate-forme d'armes orbitale. Craignant pour la sécurité du vaisseau, le capitaine [Root.GetLeaderName] ordonne au vaisseau de quitter l'orbite. 

Alors que le vaisseau fait cela, l'ancienne plate-forme d'armes semble souffrir d'une défaillance mécanique et est vaporisée. D'une manière ou d'une autre, l'énergie de l'explosion est redirigée vers le faisceau de transfert d'énergie de la plate-forme vers la planète, détruisant la zone proche du site de transmission initial et éliminant toute chance de découvrir un jour le mystère du signal.
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_fail.1.name: L'Arsenal De La Liberté
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_fail.2.desc:

Il se renseigne à plusieurs reprises sur l'intention d'achat du [Root.GetFleetName], mais ne révèle pas grand-chose avant de fermer le canal. 

Le capitaine [Root.GetLeaderName] se prépare à emmener une équipe de cadres supérieurs sur la planète, mais il est interrompu par l'apparition soudaine d'une plate-forme d'armes orbitale. Craignant pour la sécurité du vaisseau, le capitaine [Root.GetLeaderName] ordonne au vaisseau de quitter l'orbite. 

Alors que le vaisseau fait cela, l'ancienne plate-forme d'armes semble souffrir d'une défaillance mécanique et est vaporisée. D'une manière ou d'une autre, l'énergie de l'explosion est redirigée vers le faisceau de transfert d'énergie de la plate-forme vers la planète, détruisant la zone proche du site de transmission initial et éliminant toute chance de découvrir un jour le mystère du signal. 

La [Racine.ObtenirNom de la flotte] est prise dans l'explosion de la plate-forme d'armes et est détruite, tuant tout le monde.
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_fail.2.name: L'Arsenal De La Liberté
STH_babel.10.desc: Unable to attend the conference has been a major setback to peace, let us see what the future holds.
STH_babel.10.name: Babel Summit
STH_babel.11.desc:
After many years of conflict and tension, diplomats from the nearby Alpha and Beta quadrant powers have arranged a peace summit at a location codenamed 'Babel One' to chart a course for the future.

Representatives from Earth, Tellar Prime, Andoria and Vulcan will be in attendance.

 A military escort should carry our top diplomats to this conference which could change the course of galactic diplomacy in this region of space and result in each race working more closely together.
STH_babel.11.name: An invitation to join the peace summit at Babel One
STH_babel.13.desc:
Today is a momentous day, the major powers of the Alpha and Beta Quadrant have formed a strategic alliance with the goal of tackling issues together and securing the safety of 

[cop_earth.GetName] 
[cop_vulcan.GetName] 
[cop_andoria.GetName] 
[cop_tellar.GetName] 

These states will move forward together and face their challenges as a united front.
STH_babel.13.name: The Coalition of Planets Formed
STH_babel.14.desc: In a historic moment an alliance between [cop_earth.GetName] [cop_vulcan.GetName] [cop_andoria.GetName] [cop_tellar.GetName] has been formed with each government agreeing to provide mutual protection and cooperation. This will result in a major power shift within the quadrant and only time will tell what the future holds for this Coalition of Planets.
STH_babel.14.name: The Coalition of Planets Formed
STH_babel.2.desc: The summit is underway and discussions are intense, the subject turns to discussions on old rivalries and grievances. Relations between Vulcan, Andor and Tellar have fluctuated over the years and many consider Earth too young to be trusted. How can peace be built with so much history?
STH_babel.2.name: Welcome to the Babel Summit
STH_babel.21.desc: Following on from the success at the Babel Conference the ambassadors and representatives from each ot the major powers have drawn up a proposal to form an interstate alliance for mutual protection and assurance. Signing this agreement will mean the termination of any existing agreements and a commitment to joining the Coalition of Planets. This may open the way to further strengthening of this relationship.
STH_babel.21.name: Vote to form a new alliance
STH_babel.22.desc: Old wounds are hard to heal and despite the efforts of all involved at the Babel the conference descended into chaos with diplomats from all sides resorting to shouts and threats rather than talking leaving all parties in a state of outrage.
STH_babel.22.name: Babel Conference Complete
STH_babel.4.desc: Thanks to intense negotiations real progress has been made and a major breakthrough has been reached. The question remains - Is it time to build trust and look at each other in a positive light or do we forge ahead alone?
STH_babel.4.name: Time to decide the future
STH_babel.5.desc: The conference comes to an end with all sides wary of this new direction but optimistic. Perhaps the time to cement the deal with a secure coalition draws near and we can look towards the future together.
STH_babel.5.name: Babel Summit Complete
STH_babel.6.desc: The government of [Root.owner.GetName] back on [Root.capital_scope.GetName] has approved the proposal to form an interstate alliance of like minded governments across the Alpha and Beta quadrants. This alliance will be the first steps to bringing peace and security to the powers involved. Each government will need to vote on the process and the conference will reconvene in ten days to decide on their future.
STH_babel.6.name: The Coalition of Planets
STH_bajoran_flavour.1.desc:
En nettoyant le miroir de la forme 
de l'esprit avec le pollen de la Moreka 
vous assistez à la gloire sans tache des Prophètes. 
Tu es l'émissaire de confiance Tu es l'avatar d'une force incomparable. 
Toutes les tâches inatteignables dans le monde deviennent facilement réalisables avec votre grâce.

Akorem Laan devient célèbre à chaque nouveau poème qu'il écrit. Le Kai, en particulier, est connu pour trouver une grande joie dans ses œuvres, et la dernière pièce d'Akorem, La complainte de Gaudaal, ne fait pas exception à la règle.
STH_bajoran_flavour.1.name: La complainte de Gaudaal
STH_bajoran_flavour.201.desc:
Maintenant que l'excavation de B'hala est achevée, les Prophètes ont de nouveau contacté le ranjen [bhala_discoverer.GetName]. Selon eux, l'implication de [Root.GetName] dasn la communauté galactique mettrait [From.getName] en péril. Ranjen [bhala_discoverer.GetName] décrit des nuées de sauterelles descendant des étoiles pour dévorer [From.GetName].

Cette révélation divise le gouvernemen : bien que les visions de [bhal_discoverer.GetName] se soit avérées justes quant à la localisation de B'Hala, rares sont ceux prêts à abandonner les traités interstellaires et à retourner dans la réclusion.
STH_bajoran_flavour.201.name: La Cité Perdue de B'hala
STH_bajoran_flavour.202.desc:
Suite à la découverte de l'antique cité perdue de B'hala sur [FromFrom.GetName], [From.GetName] s'est retiré de la scène politique galactique et a débuté une période d'isolation.

Ranjen [FromFromFrom.GetName], la personne dont les visons religieuses ont supposément mené à la découverte de la cité, prétend avoir eu une seconde vision suggérant la ruine de [FromFrom.GetName], si les relations diplomatiques galactiques sont maintenues.
STH_bajoran_flavour.202.name: L'isolation de [From.GetName]
STH_bajoran_flavour.300.desc: Our recent integration of the planet Bajor and it's population has lead to an interesting position, Bajor has a wealth of resources and a population that we could easily enslave and put to work for the good of [Root.GetName], many on [Root.capital_scope.GetName] feel this could be an easy opportunity to plunder a world of its riches, whilst the religious fools on the planet sit helpless at our feet.
STH_bajoran_flavour.300.name: The Bajoran Question

STH_bajoran_mechanics.5.name: Death of Kai [deadBajoranKai.GetName]
STH_bajoran_mechanics.6.desc:
The [Root.GetName] mourns today as news spreads of the death of Vedek [deadBajoranVedek.GetName]. 

The Vedek Assembly will now convene to begin the process of selecting a replacement for [deadBajoranVedek.GetName], though many are open to nominations from the civilian administration.
STH_bajoran_mechanics.6.name: Death of Vedek [deadBajoranKai.GetName]
STH_bajoran_mechanics.8.desc: While the loss of the previous Kai was a blow to the [Root.GetName], the Vedek Assembly has come together to elect a new Kai to lead the Faith. The leading Vedeks have come together and will select a new Kai to guide the Bajoran people and help them walk the path of the Prophets.
STH_bajoran_mechanics.8.name: Time for the Vedeks to Elect a new Kai
STH_bajoran_mechanics.9.desc: With an open seat on the Vedek Assembly time has come to select a new Vedek to join its numbers. The assembled Ranjen, plus notable leaders with strong faith, are available to join the ranks of the Vedek Assembly to serve the people and Prophets.
STH_bajoran_mechanics.9.name: Time to appoint a new Vedek to the Assembly
STH_bajoran_story.1.desc:
Incense drifted on the southern wind through the temple interior, spilling out to the walled Ranjens' garden. A dozen shaggy-haired Dakthara lay dozing in the sun until the pack-father raised its long ears to the sound of the coming footsteps. 

'And you're sure it was a vision and not just a dream?' [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] asked Ranjen Biral. 

'Quite sure, yes. Their words were curiously arranged but they told me enough. There is an Orb we must find, the Orb of Prophecy. And we must start in the Denorios Belt.' 

The [Root.GetRulerTitle] turned [Root.Leader.GetHerHis] gaze to the sky above. 

'We'll need a ship...' the Ranjen said, absently.
STH_bajoran_story.1.name: The Orb of Prophecy
STH_bajoran_story.10.desc:
The last viable location of the subspace wake has been identified as no less than the [orbOfProphecy5Target.GetName] black hole. 

Retrieval of the Orb may prove impossible if it has had the misfortune to drop below the event horizon...
STH_bajoran_story.10.name: The Orb of Prophecy
STH_bajoran_story.1000.desc: Severe neutrino disturbances have been detected in the region of the [bajoran_system.GetName]'s Denorios Belt. [Root.GetName] scientists urge the dispatch of a scientific mission to study the anomalies.
STH_bajoran_story.1000.name: Explore the Denorios Belt
STH_bajoran_story.1005.desc: While the source of the neutrino disturbances was not discovered, the survey of the Denorios Belt has provided scientists on [Root.Capital.GetName] with gigaquads of data to pour over.
STH_bajoran_story.1005.name: Explore the Denorios Belt
STH_bajoran_story.1010.name: Explore the Denorios Belt
STH_bajoran_story.1011.desc:
A stable wormhole has been discovered in the [bajoran_system.GetName] system, apparently terminating deep in the Gamma Quadrant. 

Our analysts believe this could change the balance of power in the region.
STH_bajoran_story.1011.name: Bajoran Wormhole
STH_bajoran_story.1012.desc:
A stable wormhole has been discovered in the [idran_system.GetName] system, apparently terminating deep in the Alpha Quadrant. 

Our analysts believe this could change the balance of power in the region.
STH_bajoran_story.1012.name: Idran Wormhole
STH_bajoran_story.1013.desc: [the_emissary.GetName] wakes up in a green field, with no sign of their ship or crew. Disoriented and confused they shout out, but no one is in sight. Slowly a glowing blue-white orb floats towards the Captain getting closer and closer. Alarmed [the_emissary.GetName] reaches for their weapon.
STH_bajoran_story.1013.name: The Emissary
STH_bajoran_story.1014.desc:
<LIMBO> 

Who are you..? 

It is corporeal, a physical entity. 

Why is it here, what disruption will it bring?
STH_bajoran_story.1014.name: The Emissary
STH_bajoran_story.1015.desc:
<SHIPS BRIDGE> 

It is responding to visual and auditory stimuli. 

Linguist communication. 

It brings disruption.
STH_bajoran_story.1015.name: The Emissary
STH_bajoran_story.1016.name: The Emissary
STH_bajoran_story.1017.desc: The [emissary_ship.GetName] and [the_emissary.GetName] emerge from the Wormhole unscathed with the knowledge the Wormhole, otherwise known as the Celestial Temple to the Bajorans is the home of a race of non-corporeal beings existing outside of linear time, simultaneously aware of the past, present, and the future. Their origins remain unknown, but they claim to be 'of Bajor', they have declared [the_emissary.GetName] their Emissary and have granted safe passage through their domain.
STH_bajoran_story.1017.name: The Emissary
STH_bajoran_story.1018.desc: There has been no sign of [emissary_ship.GetName] and [the_emissary.GetName] since they went to investigate the readings in the Denorios Belt, we can only assumed their ship was destroyed.
STH_bajoran_story.1018.name: The Emissary
STH_bajoran_story.1019.desc: The arrival of the Emissary was predicted by several Bajoran writers, who wrote what they saw in several Prophecies. [the_emissary.GetName] was revealed to be the Emissary after surviving their encounter with the Prophets inside their temple, all of Bajor rejoices and their opinion of [the_emissary_country.GetName] has greatly improved for bringing their Emissary to them.
STH_bajoran_story.1019.name: The Bajoran Emissary
STH_bajoran_story.1022.desc:
The discovery of the Bajoran Wormhole is a major strategic and tactical advancement our admirals have recommended moving the local starbase to the mouth of the wormhole to stake our claim to it and make it more defendable. 

Dev Note: The Starbase in the Bajoran system will be replaced by a basic outpost and a new deep space military ship will be constructed close to the Wormhole. Before building the structure via the construction ship megastructure menu make sure that you have a Nor-Class starbase setup in your ship designer.
STH_bajoran_story.1022.name: Relocate Station to Wormhole
STH_bajoran_story.11.desc:
Disaster has struck the search for the Orb of Prophecy. While initially elated to find compelling evidence that the Orb did indeed arrive in the [orbOfProphecy5Target.GetName] system, the crew of the [Root.GetFleetName] soon turned to despair after refined measurements proved the Orb had fallen beneath the event horizon. 

[Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] appeared particularly affected by the revelation, until [Root.Leader.GetSheHe] froze in thought for several minutes on the bridge. Awakening as if from a daze, [Root.Leader.GetSheHe] muttered 'I know what must be done' before leaving in a shuttle. 

Protests from the crew of the [Root.GetFleetName] were left unanswered as the shuttle plunged deep beneath the event horizon of the black hole...
STH_bajoran_story.11.name: The Orb of Prophecy
STH_bajoran_story.12.desc:
Long minutes pass as the crew of the [Root.GetFleetName] try to comprehend the actions of [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] as [Root.Leader.GetSheHe] plunged into the black hole. Just moments before the Executive Officer would give the order to return to [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName], [Root.GetLeaderName]'s shuttle reappeared above the event horizon. 

'The Prophets rewarded my faith', [Root.Leader.GetSheHe] messaged over the communications channel.
'They have given me the Orb to protect. Now let's go home.'
STH_bajoran_story.12.name: The Orb of Prophecy
STH_bajoran_story.13.desc:
Despite some initial misgivings, [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] was convinced to entrust the safety of the Orb of Prophecy to the Kai. 

All of [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] celebrates the success of the holy expedition.
STH_bajoran_story.13.name: The Orb of Prophecy
STH_bajoran_story.14.desc:
Despite strong protest, [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] was forced to entrust the safety of the Orb of Prophecy to the Kai. 

While all of [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] celebrated the success of the holy expedition, the treatment of [Root.GetLeaderName] and [Root.Leader.GetHerHis] perceived role as protector of the Orb being denied has exposed deep divisions across the [Root.Owner.GetName].
STH_bajoran_story.14.name: The Orb of Prophecy
STH_bajoran_story.15.desc:
[Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] has been granted permanent custodianship of the Orb of Prophecy. 

All of [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] celebrates the success of the holy expedition.
STH_bajoran_story.15.name: The Orb of Prophecy
STH_bajoran_story.16.desc:
[Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] has been granted permanent custodianship of the Orb of Prophecy. 

While all of [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] celebrates the success of the holy expedition, many protest the apparent disrespect to the Kai made by [Root.GetLeaderName] in [Root.Leader.GetHerHis] refusal to allow the Orb of Prophecy to sit with the other Orbs. 

While the protests have yet to turn violent, it is clear the situation will not be forgotten any time soon.
STH_bajoran_story.16.name: The Orb of Prophecy
STH_bajoran_story.18.desc: The death of [fromfrom.GetName] has meant that the Orb of Prophecy kept in [fromfrom.GetHerHis] care can now be given to the Kai for safekeeping alongside the other Orbs.
STH_bajoran_story.18.name: The Orb of Prophecy
STH_bajoran_story.2.desc:
After extensive consultation between Ranjen Biral and the leading experts on the Denorios Belt, it appears that a clue has at last been uncovered to the location of the Orb of Prophecy. 

A surge in neutrinos was detected several months ago localised to a volume one million kilometres in diameter. Extrapolating for orbital drift leaves a region that while substantial is still surveyable.
STH_bajoran_story.2.name: The Orb of Prophecy
STH_bajoran_story.2000.desc:
While several ancient texts appeared to suggest likely locations in which an Orb of the Prophets could be found on Bajor, none of those investigated uncovered one. Several minor historical artefacts were uncovered however, resulting in the expedition being seen as at least a partial success. 

Scholars believe at least one orb is still to be uncovered, likely in one of the lost cities.
STH_bajoran_story.2000.name: Orb of the Prophets Expedition
STH_bajoran_story.2001.desc:
While several ancient texts appeared to suggest likely locations in which an Orb of the Prophets could be found on Bajor, none of those investigated uncovered one. Worse, a number of researchers were killed or injured when an underground chamber they were surveying collapsed. 

Scholars believe at least one orb is still to be uncovered, likely in one of the lost cities.
STH_bajoran_story.2001.name: Orb of the Prophets Expedition
STH_bajoran_story.2010.desc:
The Orbe de la Contemplation has been recovered by the expedition, dug out of several hundred metres of rock near the site of the ancient city of R'hali. 

The entire [Root.GetName] celebrates as another facet of the Prophets' will is revealed.
STH_bajoran_story.2010.name: Orb of the Prophets Expedition
STH_bajoran_story.2011.desc:
The Orbe de la Mémoire has been recovered by the expedition, dug out of several hundred metres of rock near the site of the ancient city of R'hali. 

The entire [Root.GetName] celebrates as another facet of the Prophets' will is revealed.
STH_bajoran_story.2011.name: Orb of the Prophets Expedition
STH_bajoran_story.2100.desc:
While verteron detectors appeared to suggest likely locations in which an Orb of the Prophets could be found in the Denorios Belt, none of those investigated uncovered one. Several kiloquads of useful data were uncovered however, resulting in the expedition being seen as at least a partial success. 

Scholars believe at least one orb is still to be uncovered in the Denorios Belt.
STH_bajoran_story.2100.name: Orb of the Prophets Expedition
STH_bajoran_story.2101.desc:
Verteron detectors failed to suggest likely locations in which an Orb of the Prophets could be found in the Denorios Belt. Worse, a tetryon surge destroyed an EPS conduit on the Expedition vessel, killing a number of the crew. 

Scholars believe at least one orb is still to be uncovered in the Denorios Belt.
STH_bajoran_story.2101.name: Orb of the Prophets Expedition
STH_bajoran_story.2110.desc:
The Orbe de la Paix has been recovered by the expedition, pulled from a subspace tetryon eddy and into normal space by the expedition ship's main deflector. 

The entire [Root.GetName] celebrates as another facet of the Prophets' will is revealed.
STH_bajoran_story.2110.name: Orb of the Prophets Expedition
STH_bajoran_story.2111.desc:
The Orbe des Âmes has been recovered by the expedition, pulled from a subspace tetryon eddy and into normal space by the expedition ship's main deflector. 

The entire [Root.GetName] celebrates as another facet of the Prophets' will is revealed.
STH_bajoran_story.2111.name: Orb of the Prophets Expedition
STH_bajoran_story.2200.desc:
While several ancient texts appeared to suggest likely locations in which an Orb of the Prophets could be found outside of the Bajoran system, none of those investigated uncovered one. Several minor alien artefacts were uncovered however, resulting in the expedition being seen as at least a partial success. 

Scholars believe at least one orb is still to be uncovered, likely in a nearby star system.
STH_bajoran_story.2200.name: Orb of the Prophets Expedition
STH_bajoran_story.2201.desc:
While several ancient texts appeared to suggest likely locations in which an Orb of the Prophets could be found outside of the Bajoran system, none of those investigated uncovered one. Worse, a number of researchers were killed or injured when an underground chamber they were surveying collapsed. 

Scholars believe at least one orb is still to be uncovered, likely in a nearby star system.
STH_bajoran_story.2201.name: Orb of the Prophets Expedition
STH_bajoran_story.2210.desc:
The Orbe du Temps has been recovered by the expedition, extracted from the vault of an alien outpost apparently abandoned for several millennia. 

The entire [Root.GetName] celebrates as another facet of the Prophets' will is revealed.
STH_bajoran_story.2210.name: Orb of the Prophets Expedition
STH_bajoran_story.2211.desc:
The Orbe de l'Unité has been recovered by the expedition, extracted from the vault of an alien outpost apparently abandoned for several millennia. 

The entire [Root.GetName] celebrates as another facet of the Prophets' will is revealed.
STH_bajoran_story.2211.name: Orb of the Prophets Expedition
STH_bajoran_story.2212.desc:
The Orbe de la Sagesse has been recovered by the expedition, extracted from the vault of an alien outpost apparently abandoned for several millennia. 

The entire [Root.GetName] celebrates as another facet of the Prophets' will is revealed.
STH_bajoran_story.2212.name: Orb of the Prophets Expedition
STH_bajoran_story.3.desc:
Months of surveying the Denorios Belt have revealed further clues as to the location of the orb. The same neutrino pulse that was originally tied to the surveyed volume has left a subspace wake on a course leaving the system. 

Astrophysicists on [Root.Capital.GetName] are rushing to localise the target location.
STH_bajoran_story.3.name: The Orb of Prophecy
STH_bajoran_story.4.desc:
The analysis of the Denorios subspace wake has proven more difficult than expected, as a number of possible end-points are implied by the data collected so far. 

While it will take several decades to resolve all possible variations, the first candidate has been identified: 

[orbOfProphecy2Target.GetName], an arid world light years away in the [orbOfProphecy2Target.Solar_System.GetName] system.
STH_bajoran_story.4.name: The Orb of Prophecy
STH_bajoran_story.5.desc:
After hours with the baking sun above them, the expedition group under [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [FromFrom.GetLeaderName] have surveyed [orbOfProphecy2Target.GetName] and found nothing. 

Before returning to the [Root.GetFleetName] [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [FromFrom.GetLeaderName] pauses, apparently lost in thought. After some concern from [Root.Leader.GetHerHis] officers, [FromFrom.GetLeaderName] claims to have had a vision from the Prophets. The Orb is not here...
STH_bajoran_story.5.name: The Orb of Prophecy
STH_bajoran_story.6.desc:
A second potential location for the Orb of Prophecy has been identified by astrophysicists on [Root.Capital.GetName]. 

Light years away in the [orbOfProphecy3Target.Solar_System.GetName] system, a barren world may hold the Prophets' gift.
STH_bajoran_story.6.name: The Orb of Prophecy
STH_bajoran_story.7.desc:
'I hate EVA work', said [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [FromFrom.GetLeaderName]'s chief of security over the away team communications link. 

'Personally I would have found it far more tolerable if we had actually found what we came for!' [FromFrom.GetLeaderName] replied. 

It appears that [orbOfProphecy3Target.GetName] was another false lead on the hunt for the Orb of Prophecy.
STH_bajoran_story.7.name: The Orb of Prophecy
STH_bajoran_story.8.desc:
Despite the lack of success so far, public participation in the hunt for the Orb of Prophecy has helped increase the computational capacity available to astrophysicists on [Root.Capital.GetName]. 

A third potential location for the Orb of Prophecy has been revealed, [orbOfProphecy4Target.GetName] - a gas giant in the [orbOfProphecy2Target.Solar_System.GetName] system. Fortunately it is believed that only one more viable target location remains uncalculated, leading many to suspect the hunt may soon be over.
STH_bajoran_story.8.name: The Orb of Prophecy
STH_bajoran_story.9.desc:
The winds of [orbOfProphecy4Target.GetName] brush about the shuttle, parked in the narrow band of the atmosphere suitable for [Root.GetSpeciesName] respiration. 

The search for the Orb has proven unsuccessful yet again. While one further candidate location is believed to be close to being calculated, [Root.GetCaptainTitle] [FromFrom.GetLeaderName] can't help but feel saddened by yet another failure. 

Opening the rear shuttle door and sitting on the edge with [FromFrom.Leader.GetHerHis] legs dangling, [FromFrom.Leader.GetSheHe] reflects for a moment before preparing the shuttle to return to the [FromFrom.GetFleetName].
STH_bajoran_story.9.name: The Orb of Prophecy
STH_borg.1.desc:
The [FromFromFrom.Species.GetBorgSpecies] vessel has been captured in [From.GetBorgCoordinates]. 
[FromFromFrom.Species.GetBorgSpecies] leader designated [FromFrom.GetName] possesses useful knowledge and experience. Assimilate.
STH_borg.1.name: Contact established with [FromFromFrom.GetName]
STH_borg.1004.desc:
La récente conquête de [FromFrom.GetName] ne peut être poursuvie tant que l'unicomplexe demeure intact. De trop nombreux systèmes de sécurité peuvent être en sommeil, n'attendant que d'assimiler notre personnel à bord de l'installation.

Afin de réduire les risques nous devons détruire [From.Get.Name]. Nous pouvons faire en sorte d'optimiser les ressources récupérée lors de la démolition ou nous concentrer sur la rétro-ingénierie des technologies borgs restantes.
STH_borg.1004.name: Appropriation de l'Unicomplexe
STH_borg.1007.desc:
[LastKilledCountryName] a été anéanti. Cette disparition a rendu la galaxie plus sûre.

Fouiller les planètes en ruine et les épaves de vaisseaux prendfra des mois, mais leur potentiel scientifique est inestimable.
STH_borg.1007.name: La fin du Collectif
STH_borg.103.desc: Le Collectif a assimilé les [from.GetName]s pour la première fois. Assignation d'une nouvelle désignation : [from.GetBorgSpecies]. Leurs spécificités biologiques seront intégrées aux nôtres.
STH_borg.103.name: Assimilation des [from.GetName]s
STH_borg.106.desc: Suffisament d'individus [from.GetBorgSpecies] ont été assimilés ; les bénéfices technologiques marginaux ont atteint un plateau. Bien qu'apporter la perfection à plus de membres de l'[from.GetBorg.Species] resterait avantageux pour le Collectif, nous devons continuez l'assimilation de nouvelles espèces afin de nous améliorer.
STH_borg.106.name: Assimilation des [from.GetName]s
STH_borg.3.desc:
Nous sommes les Borg abaissez vos boucliers et rendez-vous sans condition. Nous intégrerons vos caractéristiques biologiques et technologiques aux nôtres. Votre culture s'adaptera à nos besoins. 

TOUTE RESISTANCE SERAIT FUTILE
STH_borg.3.name: Transmission entrante
STH_borg.301.desc:
Nos forces ont libéré [FROMFROM.GetName] du Collectif. La gestion des drones restant sur la planète semble, toutefois, d'une difficulté incommensurable.

Comme ce monde appartenait originellement à [FROM.GetName], nous pouvons le leur rendre. Nous pouvons aussi en conserver le contrôle, au risque de nous voir submergés par la population de drones.
STH_borg.301.name: Désassimilation
STH_borg.302.desc: Nos forces ont libéré [FROMFROM.GetName] du Collectif. La gestion des drones restant sur la planète semble, toutefois, d'une difficulté incommensurable.
STH_borg.302.name: Désassimilation
STH_borg.303.desc: Les forces de [from.GetName] ont libéré [FROMFROM.GetName] du Collectif et l'ont rendue à [Root.GetName]. La gestion des drones restant sur la planète semble, toutefois, d'une difficulté incommensurable.
STH_borg.303.name: Désassimilation
STH_borg.5.desc:
Mapping complete. [This.capital_scope.GetName] astrometric nodes are now tracking all known star formations in prime galactic cluster. Ready for survey operations. 

Visual display update possible. 

This event provides Borg players with the option to convert the map naming scheme to a more lore-friendly one. Recommended only for experienced users in single player campaigns.
STH_borg.5.name: Borg Spatial Mapping
STH_borg.5001.desc:
In the wreckage of a Borg vessel our engineers have uncovered an intact Transwarp node complete with computer algorithm that allows the safe navigation of these treacherous tunnels through space. 

Our scientists believe they can reverse engineer the tech and allow us to use Borg Transwarp Conduits to travel through space.
STH_borg.5001.name: Borg Transwarp Node Discovered
STH_borg.6001.name: Vaisseau hostile capturé
STH_borg.6002.desc: Nous avons achevé l'assimilation technologique et biologique d'un vaisseau capturé. Il a été rendu compatible avec la perfection borg et est désormais prêt à servir.
STH_borg.6002.name: Le vaisseau a été assimilé.
STH_borg.6004.desc: Le Cube représente le summum de la perfection borg, Pour le construire, nos drones ont combiné les conceptions imparfaites de vaisseaux inférieurs en les ajustant à nos besoins. Cette accomplissement est la preuve que nous nous approchons de la perfection, un symbole dévoilée au regard des autres espèces..
STH_borg.6004.name: Cube prêt à être déployé
STH_borg.6006.desc: Malgré la destruction de la cible, nos drones ont récupéré quantité de matériaux, qui seront utiles au Collectif.
STH_borg.6006.name: Cible d'assimilation détruite
STH_borg.6007.desc: Danger ! Avant l'auto-destruction du vaisseau ennemi, son équipage a téléchargé un virus dans le neuroprocesseur d'un drone vaincu. Ce virus a été accidentellement transmis à [borg_assimilator_vessel.GetName], provoquant son explosion. Le code malveillant a été isolé et détruit. Nous nous adapterons à cette perte.
STH_borg.6007.name: Vaisseau saboté
STH_borg.6101.desc: La destruction du module tactique désigné [FromFrom.GetName] nous a permis d'analyser l'armement utiliser contre le Collectif. Tous nos vaisseaux réallouerons les ressources tactiques vers les systèmes défensifs jusqu'au déploiement de la mise-à-jour. Nous sommes le Borg. Toute résistance est futile.
STH_borg.6101.name: Adapatation réactive enclenchée
STH_borg.6102.desc: Nous avons abattu un vaisseau borg ; il semble que le reste de leurs forces se concntre sur la défense le temsp de s'adapter. Nos flottes effectue une boucle d'urgence de nos fréquences d'armement pour contrer la tactique du Collectif. Cela nous prendra plusieurs jours.
STH_borg.6102.name: Les Borgs se sont adaptés
STH_borg.6160.name: Les Borgs s'adaptent
STH_borg.6201.desc: The [borg_invaded_ship.GetName] is reporting that is has lost contact with its engineering section with temperatures reaching 39.1 degrees celsius, shortly after this report we lost contact with the ship. Sensor readings suggest that Borg drones were beamed on board the ship shortly before the destruction of their ship. The Borg will look to establish a collective onboard the ship and attempt to take control of the vessel. The crew will either look to initiate the self-destruct or the riskier approach which is to fight off the drones.
STH_borg.6201.name: Borg presence detected on our ship
STH_borg.6202.desc: In a meaningless display of resistance, an enemy ship that was boarded by [borg_assimilator_vessel.GetName] has self-destructed, denying its primitive crew the gift of assimilation.
STH_borg.6202.name: Assimilation target destroyed
STH_borg.6203.desc: As the enemy vessel [borg_invaded_ship.GetName] attempted to disengage, [borg_assimilator_vessel.GetName] successfully beamed a group of drones aboard. The drones will commence assimilation protocols and begin the assimilation of the target. Its technological distinctiveness will be adapted to service us.
STH_borg.6203.name: Assimilation Protocol Engaged
STH_borg.6205.desc: The last transmission from the [borg_invaded_ship.GetName] indicated that the Borg had control over 90% of the ship, including navigation and the ships engines. We must presume that the crew have been either killed or have suffered a worse fate. The ship has powered up its engines and disappeared leaving only a transwarp signature heading deep into Borg territory where the Borg will complete the assimilation of our ship.
STH_borg.6205.name: Ship lost to the Borg Collective
STH_borg.6206.desc: We are receiving a transmission from our missing ship, it appears they were successful in repelling the Borg invasion of their ship. The Collective has suffered a mighty defeat today and a line has been drawn... this far and no further! With control re-established over the ship it has been returned to full operational readiness. We may even be able to learn from some of the leftover Borg technology.
STH_borg.6206.name: Ship repelled Borg invasion
STH_borg.6207.desc: Efforts to assimilate the [borg_invaded_ship.GetName] were unsuccessful. All drones assigned to this task have been neutralized by enemy defenders. Resetting target priority and updating drone expenditure projections to compensate.
STH_borg.6207.name: Assimilation target lost
STH_borg.6300.desc:
During our assimilation of the [From.GetName], the Collective successfully abducted an individual from the enemy's primitive leadership hierarchy. This drone's mind possesses extensive data regarding its species' technology and battle strategies. We have assimilated this leader, now designated [FromFrom.GetName], to facilitate operations against the [FromFromFrom.GetName].

Assign leader directive.
STH_borg.6300.name: Leader Assimilated
STH_borg.6301.desc: In a disastrous turn of events, our leader aboard the [From.GetName] has been abducted and assimilated by the Borg. [FromFrom.GetSheHeCap] has hailed our forces, demanding our immediate surrender. We must consider the dire reality that we are now fighting against the knowledge and experience of the person [FromFrom.GetSheHe] once was.
STH_borg.6301.name: Leader Assimilated
STH_borg.6302.desc: In a textbook display of cunning and decisive action, crew from the [From.GetName] have successfully prevented [FromFrom.GetName] from being assimilated by the Borg. Though the loss of the [From.GetName] is unfortunate, [FromFrom.GetName] has vowed to take the fight back to the Borg as soon as [FromFrom.GetSheHe] is assigned to a new command. We were very lucky today.
STH_borg.6302.name: Leader Escaped Assimilation
STH_borg.6502.desc: Bombardment and extraction operation, successful. Collective Tactical vessel has now harvested enough material from the planet designated [borg_scope_location.GetName] to construct a new Borg tactical asset, based on the size of the planetary harvest, a new vessel is available to command.
STH_borg.6502.name: City Harvest Successful
STH_borg.6503.desc: The Borg have harvested the infrastructure from [borg_scope_location.GatName] and converted the people and resources into a new Borg vessel.
STH_borg.6503.name: City Havested by the Borg
STH_borg.7001.desc: The [borg_invaded_fleet.GetName] is collapsing into chaos now that the Borg have adapted to the last of its weapons. We are receiving reports of Borg drones on nearly all remaining ships. Security teams are attempting to repel the invaders, but should they be defeated it is likely we will lose the fleet to the Collective.
STH_borg.7001.name: Fleet compromised by Borg drones
STH_borg.7002.desc: Despite the best efforts of our crews, the Borg presence throughout the [borg_invaded_fleet.GetName] was too strong and our defences were overrun. We are flagging the fleet as lost and potentially hostile.
STH_borg.7002.name: [borg_invaded_fleet.GetName] has been lost to the Borg
STH_borg.7004.desc: We are receiving a transmission from the [borg_invaded_fleet.GetName], it appears they were successful in repelling the Borg invasion of their ships. The Collective has suffered a mighty defeat today and a line has been drawn... this far and no further! With control re-established over the fleet it has been returned to full operational readiness. We may even be able to learn from some of the leftover Borg technology.
STH_borg.7004.name: Fleet repelled Borg invasion
STH_borg.7005.desc: Our fleet was able to partially defeat the Borg, but unfortunately the [borg_invaded_fleet_ship.GetName] was lost with all hands in the process. The remaining ships were able to rid themselves of the Borg incursion and escape the battle.
STH_borg.7005.name: [borg_invaded_fleet.GetName] ship destroyed
STH_borg.7006.desc: We have fully adapted against the [borg_invaded_fleet.Owner.GetName]'s [borg_invaded_fleet.GetName]. Scans indicate it no longer has sufficient ships or crew to resist direct assault via mass-transport of tactical drones. Remodulate all transporter beams to penetrate enemy shields. Prepare drones for deployment.
STH_borg.7006.name: Assimilation Protocol Engaged
STH_borg.7007.desc: In an act of desperation, a fleet engaging our forces self-destructed its ships rather than allow them to be assimilated. The loss of deployed drones is irrelevant. We will adapt.
STH_borg.7007.name: Assimilation Target Self-Destructed
STH_borg.7008.desc: Tactical drone numbers were insufficient, resulting in failure to assimilate the enemy fleet. Regroup and pursue targets.
STH_borg.7008.name: Assimilation Attempt Failed
STH_borg.7009.desc: We have secured control of the [From.GetName]. We will begin analyzing and assimilating its biological and technological distinctiveness. Approximately 30 to 90 computing cycles required for this task. Irrelevant vessels will be disassembled for resources. Remaining vessels will be adapted to service us.
STH_borg.7009.name: Fleet Secured
STH_borg.7010.desc: We have analyzed several vessels from recently captured fleets and found no further distinctiveness worth assimilating. These ships have therefore been redirected to [Root.Capital.GetName] for disassembly. The resources and drones aboard will be redistributed throughout the Collective, bringing us closer to perfection.
STH_borg.7010.name: Captured Vessels Repurposed
STH_borg.7020.desc:
Assimilation Protocols Completed. Drones aboard asset designated [borg_ship_convert.GetName] have completed the assimilation of the vessel and are ready to return the unit to [Root.Capital_scope.GetName] to complete its full integration into the collective.

Secondary protocols now engaged...
STH_borg.7020.name: Assimilation Protocols Complete
STH_borg.7051.desc:
Assimilation Units have breached the defences of ship designate [This.GetName], primary assimilation objective engaged, drones will attempt to gain control of vessels primary systems. 

Secondary Obective Begin assimilation of ships organic element.
STH_borg.7051.name: [This.GetName] Under Assimilation
STH_borg.7052.desc: The organic crew have resisted our attempts to gain control over the assimilation target and have terminated the existence of the vessel, crew and all drones onboard.
STH_borg.7052.name: [This.GetName] Destroyed
STH_borg.8.desc: Through the process of assimilation, the Collective accumulates vast quantities of data that must be collated and archived. Periodic review of information stored in auxiliary data nodes may yield new technological advances that can be assimilated into our own. If no distinctiveness can be found, the £ Unity of the Collective will be increased instead.
STH_borg.8.name: Data Assimilation
STH_borg.9001.desc: Our forces report that they have concluded the orbital bombardment of [From.GetName]. All active Borg drones have been deactivated and the Borg structure appears powerless and in ruin. We now have to make a decision on what to do with the structure. The safest option is to destroy what remains of the facility and lay to rest the drones that were once individuals, however our scientists are eager to get their hands on the technology which would greatly boost our own.
STH_borg.9001.name: [From.GetName] Bombarded
STH_borg.9002.desc:
A fleet belonging to the [From.From.GetName] has destroyed [From.GetName]. All Borg units have been rendered inoperable. Our adaption algorithms were unable to adapt quickly enough to neutralise threat. Target losses are unacceptable, appropriate counter-measures engaged.

Resistance must be brought to acceptable levels, further loss to the Collective cannot be permitted.
STH_borg.9002.name: [From.GetName] Destroyed
STH_borg.9003.desc: [borg_facility_leader.GetName] has reported back from their assignment on the derelict Borg facility with positive news, they have successfully managed to tap into a fraction of the Collectives database and download terrabytes of valuable research information from under the nose of the Collective. The research crews are eager to leave the strange facility as soon as possible.
STH_borg.9003.name: Borg Facility Successfully investigated
STH_borg.9004.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] we have worrying news from the [borg_science_ship.GetName], we have lost all communications from the ship, the last transmission we received was an update log and then a broken communication from the ship. It appears they attempted to bring a number of dead drones back onboard the [borg_science_ship.GetName] for further study.

Worryingly the last message we received was a broken distress call from the second officer reporting that [borg_facility_leader.GetName] had been assimilated and that the Borg now controlled over 95% of the ship. All communications have been lost since that point and we can only assume the ship has been assimilated by the Borg!
STH_borg.9004.name: Science Ship Assimilated
STH_borg.9005.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] we have worrying news from the [borg_science_ship.GetName], we have lost all communications from the ship, the last transmission we received was an update log and then a broken communication from the ship. It appears they attempted to bring a number of dead drones back onboard the [borg_science_ship.GetName] for further study.

We received a final transmission from the [borg_science_ship.GetName] claiming that the Borg were attempting to take control of [borg_science_ship.GetName], [borg_science_ship.GetHerHis] final order was to activate the ships self-destruct command to prevent the ship being lost to the borg.
STH_borg.9005.name: Science Ship Destroyed
STH_borg.9006.desc: Assimilation Report Complete, drone reactivation successful. Tactical assets have successfully completed the assimiliation of [borg_science_ship.GetName] the vessel will now serve the collective.
STH_borg.9006.name: Assimilation Complete
STH_borg.9007.desc: It appears that the Borg have invested the considerable resources of the collective into adapting to our defenses, it appears are shields currently offer little protection against their weaponary.
STH_borg.9007.name: The Borg Have Adapted
STH_borg.9008.desc: Adaption Protocol Engaged. Enemy defenses have been analysed and tactical weaknesses have been assessed. Our tactical threat has been increased for a short duration.
STH_borg.9008.name: Adaption Protocol Engaged
STH_borg.9009.desc: We have successfully managed to re-modulate our shields, removing the increased damage the Borg are able to inflict on our vessels.
STH_borg.9009.name: Shields Remodulated
STH_borg.9010.desc: Assimilation Target has adapted its defenses. Collective weapon threat has returned to regular levels. Continue assimilation drive. Their resistance is futile.
STH_borg.9010.name: Species have Remodulated their Defense
STH_borg.9101.desc:
The destruction of Cube [FromFrom.GetName] has activated the emergency Sphere ejection protocol. 

Sphere designation [borgSphereTemp.GetName] is now active.
STH_borg.9101.name: Cube Destruction Emergency Protocol
STH_borg.9102.desc: As the debris from the Borg Cube clears, a smaller Borg Sphere emerges from the destruction of the Cube and enters the battle.
STH_borg.9102.name: A Sphere emerges!
STH_borg_anomaly.1.name: Anomalous Moon
STH_borg_anomaly.2.name: Anomalous Moon
STH_borg_anomaly.3.desc:
It appears that some of [From.GetName]'s flora has developed effective defense mechanisms through natural selection. Numerous trees and fungi exude spores that act like a powerful acidic on non-plant organisms. 

Leadership node [Root.GetLeaderName] successfully determined a countermeasure to the more damaging strands of these spores, making the planet's forests less corrosive to organic tissues, however not before several drones were irreparably damaged.
STH_borg_anomaly.3.name: Acidic Flora
STH_borg_crisis.1.desc:
Throughout the Alpha and Beta quadrants, strange readings have appeared that appeared to be linked to the theoretical branch of transwarp technology. The [Root.GetName] has only limited data about this method of transport, which is theorised to allow faster than warp travel throughout the universe.

Whilst ships have been reported missing near to these transwarp anomalies, by the time any [Root.GetSpeciesName] vessel gets close to the distress call the area has already stabilised. What should we do?
STH_borg_crisis.1.name: Transwarp Anomaly
STH_borg_crisis.100.name: INCOMING TRANSMISSION
STH_borg_crisis.2.desc:
Long range scans have detected a series of odd ship deployments in [From.GetName] space.

So far our tacticians have been unable to determine the intent behind the [From.GetName]'s actions.
STH_borg_crisis.2.name: Strange Readings
STH_borg_crisis.250.desc:
The gigantic cube continues to assault [borgAssimilatingPlanet.GetName], decimating the population.

Our long range scans suggest the planet's atmosphere has been terraformed into one with high concentrations of fluorine, carbon monoxide and methane.
STH_borg_crisis.250.name: Borg Cube
STH_borg_crisis.260.desc:
